description:
age file encryption (age-encryption.org/v1), in pure V.

Implements the C2SP age specification (https://c2sp.org/age): the file header (parse, canonical serialization and header MAC), the native X25519 and scrypt recipient stubs with their Bech32 key encodings, and the payload: the STREAM chunked ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption scheme. Every component is checked against the official test vectors (see Verification).
name: gil-silva.age
